newsitem.title: UK: Euro feeds start quiet on holiday affected market.
newsitem.headline: Euro feeds start quiet on holiday affected market.

text.p: European feeds started quiet on Wednesday morning on a thin market owing to the Queen's Day holiday in the Netherlands.
Prices, where quoted, were mostly higher but brokers held out little prospect on any trading.
"The Dutch are on holiday today and most of the rest of the European Union on Thursday so I don't see much chance of any business," said one.
Rapemeal ex-mill lower Rhine opened 0.25 marks up while south American sun pellets were $1 up from Tuesday's close.
